title: libexpat now funded by the City of Munich for up to 6 months
summary: The City of Munich is funding libexpat's maintainer for up to 6 months as an open source sabbatical, allowing dedicated time to work on this widely-used C-based XML parsing library. This represents a novel approach to sustaining critical open source infrastructure through government support.
problem_solved: Addresses the challenge of maintaining critical open source infrastructure like libexpat by providing dedicated funding for maintainers.
why_valuable: Demonstrates a sustainable model for open source maintenance where municipalities can directly fund essential digital infrastructure they depend on.
